notes: Raw snapshots keep original false flags, local paths, tool versions, failures and timeouts.
The pre-final read-only audit correctly records performance/rechecks as pending at its own observation time.
The package runner records the specific local execution paths; use the committed tools with equivalent pinned installations on another host.
Exact executable bytes are retained for the strict Rust benchmark; NDU measure_pair retains artifact identities and emitted sources but removes its temporary libraries.
